query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-25T09:28:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-25T09:31:00.000Z"
        AND falco.rule == "Adding ssh keys to authorized_keys"
| KEEP @timestamp, falco.rule, `falco.output_fields.fd.name`, `falco.output_fields.user.name`, `falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline`, `falco.output_fields.container.id`, `falco.output_fields.evt.type`
| SORT @timestamp ASC

values.falco.output_fields.fd.name: /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
values.falco.output_fields.user.name: root
values.falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline:
bash -lc mkdir -p /root/.ssh && chmod 700 /root/.ssh
ts=$(date +%s)
echo "ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAAD_fake_key_0_${ts}_attacker attacker@elsewhere" \
  >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
ls -la /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
